messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the reference person's hairstyle, hair color, or expression. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman turns her head from a side profile to face the camera, then raises her hand to touch her hair and ear area before turning her head away again.","camera":"A medium close-up, eye-level shot that remains relatively static while the subject moves within the frame.","clothing":"She wears a bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with black straps and black graphic details on the sleeves.","hair_color":"The hair is black with a prominent blonde section in the bangs.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with short, blunt bangs across her forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, a slim build, and a small nose ring.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome structure with pink and blue lighting in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains visually almost identical to the source: same 3D character, same black hair with blonde bangs, same pink top, same futuristic scene, and the same head-turning and hair-touching motion. No clear facial-feature change toward the reference person is visible, and the body skin tone appears unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's identity to match the reference photo, including facial features and body skin tone, while preserving the original hairstyle, hair color, expression, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Whether any very subtle facial identity change occurred is difficult to judge from the provided frames.
